name: Gaia
source:
Gaia has been obsessed with travel and seeing the world all her existence, but no matter how hard she tries, she feels like her world is just spinning in circles, never actually going anywhere! Consumed with a wanderlust that can never be fullfilled, Gaia is obssesed with stories. She loves to listen to the tales of others and live vicariously through them, collecting them in a mental scrapbook. Can you help her see the world that she represents so well?
Likes: Yearnin', Imaginin', Spinnin'
 Dislikes: Speakin' plain

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
